goal: Allows wallet users to send bitcoin to BIP 352 silent payment addresses
Improves transaction privacy on chain for both senders and recipients
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob, polespinasa, davidgumberg)
Verified compatibility against btclib-wallet across hundreds of test transactions (fametrano)
Verified key filtering and fee bumping behavior in wallet tests (Yudis-bit)
Answered objection: fee bumping after backup restore can cause scanning to miss outputs (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it brings a substantial privacy upgrade to wallet payments for users
It unblocks subsequent support for silent payment receiving
